messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGE: gpu-capacity-exhaustion - High queue growth for realtime inference (p90 latency > 4s). Paging olivia (oncall) and eng-sre.

olivia (oncall): seeing large enqueue spikes on gpu-pool-realtime, queues up ~3k requests, autoscaler not adding nodes.  p95 latency 4.8s, errors ramping. tagging this P1.

sam (sre): confirmed. cluster-autoscaler logs show repeated attach-role failures and LaunchTemplate version mismatch during scale-up. errors: `AttachRolePolicyDenied` then `LaunchTemplateVersionInvalid`.

tai (infra): getting the autoscaler pod logs now, looks like a race with an in-progress nodegroup instance-refresh. Autoscaler requests nodes -> ASG rejects because instance-refresh locks launch template -> new nodes spin without required GPU taint/driver bootstrap -> kubelet rejects pods.

maria (runtime): so nodes are coming but not ready for scheduling GPU pods? that would explain queue growth. any events from the pods?

sam (sre): pod events: `0/52 nodes are available: 52 node(s) didn't match pod's nodeSelector, 52 Insufficient nvidia.com/gpu`. indicating nodes launched but no GPU annotations (driver not installed / taint mismatch). excerpt:```Events:
  Warning  FailedScheduling  5s (x10 over 2m)  default-scheduler  0/52 nodes are available: 52 Insufficient nvidia.com/gpu.```

olivia (oncall): tagging customers with ongoing requests. jordan, can you reach out to the highest-traffic tenants and advise degraded performance?

jordan (support): on it. I'll message the top 3 Paid tenants with ETA approx 30m, offering mitigation steps.

ash (prodops): quick mitigation proposal: 1) scale up a CPU-backed fallback nodegroup and route low-priority traffic there; 2) pause instance-refresh on the GPU ASG; 3) manual bump of LaunchTemplate to matching version + ensure attach-role policy is valid; 4) restart cluster-autoscaler. thoughts?

tai (infra): agree with pause instance-refresh. AWS shows instance-refresh in progress for `gpu-pool-asg` started ~10m before autoscaler spike -> this explains `LaunchTemplateVersionInvalid`. I'll pause and cancel it.

sam (sre): autoscaler also showing errors from STS: `AccessDenied: sts:AssumeRole` when trying to attach IAM instance profile. looks like the instance profile role used by ASG was rotated and the attach-role permission hasn't propagated. possible cause: recent rollout of attach-role permissions change.

maria (runtime): to reduce customer impact fast we can: 1) enable fallback: route `priority:low` requests to cpu-realtime route; 2) drain non-GPU pods off problematic nodes; 3) temp scale GPU target to max+1 while we stabilize. I'll prepare the routing toggle.

olivia (oncall): execute mitigations in that order. sam/tai, you take infra actions. ash, coordinate with jordan on customer comms. I'll own incident timeline and paging.

ash (prodops): applying CPU fallback now. toggling traffic rules:```# prodops routing toggle
POST /routes/modify {
  "route": "realtime",
  "rule": "if priority==low -> cpu-realtime"
}```done — low-priority requests rerouted, expected drop in overall queue in ~30s.

jordan (support): notified tenants: Sent messages to Customer A/B/C, flagged as P1 degradation, suggested retry/backoff for clients, offered temporary throughput reduction until we fix.

tai (infra): cancelled instance-refresh on ASG (`aws autoscaling cancel-instance-refresh --auto-scaling-group-name gpu-pool-asg`). ASG reported 0 in-progress. next I'll manually set LaunchTemplate to version that matches provisioned AMI + attach correct instance profile.

sam (sre): looking at AWS console, the instance profile ARN returned 403 when the autoscaler tried to attach. I can manually attach profile to new launch template version via CLI. running:`aws ec2 create-launch-template-version --launch-template-id lt-0abcd --source-version 3 --launch-template-data '{"IamInstanceProfile":{"Arn":"arn:aws:iam::123456:instance-profile/gpu-node-profile-v2"}}'`

maria (runtime): while infra fixes are working, I'm scaling GPU pod replicas down for non-critical services to free slots: `kubectl scale deploy --selector=app!=realtime -n prod --replicas=0` (will bring back after).

sam (sre): after creating LT version with correct IAM, manually set as default: `aws ec2 modify-launch-template --launch-template-id lt-0abcd --default-version 4`. then start a controlled nodegroup scale: `aws autoscaling set-desired-capacity --auto-scaling-group-name gpu-pool-asg --desired-capacity 12`.

tai (infra): starting desired-capacity bump. note: we hit account-level vCPU/GPU quota earlier today; I've already requested an emergency quota increase — still pending. this scale uses reserved capacity we had available, hope it's sufficient.

incident-bot: sla-breach-check: p90 latency exceeded SLO for 23 minutes. Incident severity: P1 (external impact).

olivia (oncall): timeline note: root cause suspected: instance-refresh race + IAM attach-role permission propagation delay -> nodes created without expected instance profile and GPU drivers -> kubelet reports Insufficient GPU -> autoscaler keeps trying and hitting LaunchTemplate/AttachRole errors (ratebounce).

ash (prodops): cpu fallback reduced queue by ~65% within 2m, p95 down to 2.1s. still seeing ~300 queued realtime requests for paid tenants.

sam (sre): new nodes launched with LT v4 are registering with GPU taint/labels. kubelet logs show driver bootstrap ok. re-scheduling in progress.

maria (runtime): confirming pods are now schedulable onto new nodes: `kubectl get pods -n prod -o wide | grep realtime | grep Running` shows steady increase.

jordan (support): customers A/B/C confirm partial recovery for their traffic, still seeing occasional spikes. updated them with ETA + rollback options.

olivia (oncall): moving to containment->mitigation->postmortem. containment: cpu fallback, pause instance-refresh, manual LT fix, manual scale. mitigation: rollback attach-role changes / add guard for concurrent instance-refresh + autoscaler.

sam (sre): opened a follow-up ticket: `AS-9481` - autoscaler should detect in-progress instance-refresh and backoff; add logic to avoid repeated LT create on failure. also `AS-9482` - add preflight IAM check for instance profile attach.

tai (infra): operational task: add ASG tag `no-instance-refresh-when-autoscale=1` for GPU groups, and add a small admission check in infra pipeline.

maria (runtime): post-incident: create an eval to simulate nodegroup instance-refresh during traffic spike and validate autoscaler behavior. also add a runbook step to flip CPU-fallback route.

ash (prodops): rolling back CPU fallback 20m after steady state: toggling route back.

incident-bot: incident update: severity remains P1, customer impact partially mitigated, oncall leads scheduling postmortem.

olivia (oncall): final status: systems stable, GPU pool healthy, queue drained. I'll schedule the incident retrospective for tomorrow 11:00 PT. please add notes and signal any follow-ups. thanks all for quick coordination. :heart:

sam (sre): raw logs / snippets attached below for postmortem:```autoscaler.log: ERROR attach-role failed: AccessDenied: sts:AssumeRole
autoscaler.log: WARN launch template version mismatch: requested v4 != default v3 -> cannot create instance.
aws: Cancelled instance-refresh id: if-0a1b2c3d
```

tai (infra): done: added temporary CloudWatch alarm for `InstanceRefreshInProgress` on gpu-pool-asg and alert to eng-sre if true.

maria (runtime): follow-ups: add automated traffic fallback, autoscaler instance-refresh backoff, IAM preflight tests. assigned owners in ticket tracker.

olivia (oncall): closing thread. will upload timeline and postmortem doc to #postmortems and link customers.
